entry.title: Honor the windowMs option in the rate limiter
entry.why: Callers pass windowMs, but limits behave like the default 60 s window.
entry.what: src/limiter.js reads `window` instead of the documented `windowMs` option; read `windowMs` there. index.js is frozen; do not touch it. Run `node --test tests/`; every test passes.
